answers.text:
Commands:

In the chat (everyone):
/stop - silence for the whole chat for 24 hours
/mute - no reply: mute yourself; as a reply to someone else, owner only
/unmute - no reply: unmute yourself; as a reply to someone else, owner only
/ex add - as a reply to a bot message, owner only: add the pair to few-shot

In a private chat (owner only):
/panic - stop until /resume
/resume - clear panic and /stop
/status - short state of the bot
/last [n] - the bot's latest replies (default 5, max 20)
/why [hours] - why the bot stayed silent in the last N hours (default 1)
/get [key|prefix] - config parameters; an exact key shows its description, type and range
/set <key> <value> - change a parameter without a restart; lists in YAML: [a, b]
/unset <key> - reset a parameter to the yaml default
/prompt [full] - the current system prompt
/rollback <version> - roll the prompt back to a version
/ex last [n] - the latest few-shot examples
/ex rm [n] - delete the n-th few-shot example from the end
/life <text> - news about yourself: remember it and tell the chat right away
/life list | rm N | post N - events: list, delete, repeat
/say <text> - say this to the chat word for word
/ask <text> - what the bot would answer to such a message; nothing is sent to the chat
/memory [list|rm N|run] - long-term chat memory: weekly summaries
/diary [rm N] - facts about itself from the past week (day diary): list, delete
/jokes [rm N] - the chat's jokes it remembers: list, delete
/people [rm N] - open stories about people for a follow-up question: list, delete
/words [show|on|off|rm <name>] - word dictionaries; to upload, send a file captioned /words
/changelog [owner|<version>] - what is new: the chat block or the owner block
/help - this help
